name: A Donation of Wool
label: Quest
description: Ironforge is accepting wool cloth donations to support its stores. Sixty pieces earn full recognition for your generosity.
intro: Ironforge is accepting wool cloth donations to support its stores. Sixty pieces earn full recognition for your generosity.

clips.title: Progress
paras: We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth. A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Ironforge for your generous actions. Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.
If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, friend!

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
